ownership: Iowa Child Care Connect; Iowa State University with Iowa HHS funding and multiple provider/agency source systems.
allowed_use: User-authorized bounded internal collection of publicly displayed center/preschool directory fields
Offline source-candidate processing with provenance, unknown operating status and explicit geographic quality gaps
prohibited_use: Retention of home-provider rows or fields outside the selected whitelist
Recovery of hidden non-referral contact or opening details
Interpreting vacancies, referral eligibility or map inclusion as verified current operations
Public redistribution without separate field-level export review
Credentials, access-control bypass, automatic retries or unbounded polling
attribution: Iowa Child Care Connect, Iowa State University and Iowa HHS; retain source URL, observation time, source response fingerprint and transformation version.
retention: Retain immutable center-only selected releases and sanitized request checkpoints internally. Discard the mixed response and all unselected provider values after projection. Preserve retained releases for offline reuse rather than promotion repulls.
redistribution: Public export is not authorized by this internal policy. No blanket public-domain grant or separate data license is inferred from public availability.
personal_data_handling: Strict whitelist: businessType, businessName, address, city, zipCode, latitude, longitude, referral. Only building display-class rows retained; no contact fields, home records or nested values. Referral=false never enables recovery of withheld information.
scope_basis: Publisher guide defines center icon/filter as licensed centers or preschools; pinned current client binds that icon/filter to businessType building. Display class is not a live license verification.
freshness: Observation timestamp is known; publisher record updates and operating validity remain unknown. Vacancy dashboard definitions are not transferred into map business status.
